audit.whatIsWrong: Ruthless Predator is quoted at a 13s cooldown, and nothing anywhere says that its empowered version destroys damage shields — while the entry actively tells the player to 'Tank his empowered dash aggression with W Courage'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.' Courage IS a damage shield. So the current advice spends Garen's 22s defensive cooldown into the one ability in Renekton's kit that deletes it outright, and eats a 1.5s stun instead of a 0.75s one. Its real cooldown is 16/14/12/10/8s, not 13s.
audit.corrected: Hold Courage until his empowered W is spent — at 50+ Fury it destroys shields — and treat 16s at rank 1 as the window.

notes: Highest-value fix here is the shield interaction: empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields, and the entry was explicitly telling the player to spend Courage into it. Level chart proposed as one atomic group across both layers, resolving a direct self-contradiction at Level 1 (win[0] said Garen while its own why said Renekton). The difficulty/carry trio (diffRating, carryRating, breakdown.difficulty, report[14].t) was brought into line with diff='FAV', breakdown.carry 6.5/10 and the 56.42% win rate — all four edited together so they cannot disagree. Packet defect 'never names any of Renekton's abilities' is now only partly true: the content layer does name Cull the Meek and Ruthless Predator; the boilerplate full-layer blocks still carry the generic focus string 'Renekton Fury scaling and Slice and Dice dash'.
